item.title: LACLIL Call for Papers 2020-2
item.description: LACLIL is a peer-reviewed, open-access journal focused on CLIL (Content and Language Integrated Learning), multilingualism, interculturality, and CALL (computer-assisted language learning), throughout Latin America and around the world aimed at teachers, researchers, & educational administrators who are interested in researching, implementing, or improving language-learning approaches, techniques, materials, and policies. At the time of writing, LACLIL is indexed by the following organizations:

item.title: LACLIL Vol. 13 No. 2 published
item.description: Nos complace anunciar la publicación del Vol. 13 No. 2. de la Revista Latinoamericana de Aprendizaje Integrado de Contenidos y Idiomas (LACLIL): https://laclil.unisabana.edu.co/index.php/LACLIL/issue/current Este nuevo número - y todos los números anteriores - de LACLIL están disponibles gratuitamente en el sitio web de la revista.

item.title: LACLIL news
item.description: Dear all, This short email is to announce that Dr. Darío Luis Banegas (University of Strathclyde, UK) has become the new LACLIL Journal Editor-in-Chief (temporary) as from 2 September 2021. With best wishes, LACLIL Editorial Team

item.title: LACLIL 14(1) - Issue published
item.description: Dear LACLIL community, We are delighted to announce that Vol. 14, No. 1 of the Latin American Journal of Content and Language Integrated Learning (LACLIL) is now available at https://laclil.unisabana.edu.co/index.php/LACLIL/issue/current This new issue -- and all previous issues -- of LACLIL are freely available from the journal's website. item.title: New Editor in Chief
item.description: Dear LACLIL community, We are delighted to announce that Laura Carreño-Bolívar is now the Editor-in-Chief of the Latin American Journal of Content and Language Integrated Learning (LACLIL). Dr. Dario Banegas will assume the Associated Editor position. These changes are part of the alliance between Universidad de La Sabana and The University of Edinburgh starting 2022-2.
